notes.title: Decorate Delightful Dioramas - Twinkleby is Out Now! ✨
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/334bdbc89609b772e9106174467a580ba8bb8b21.jpg[/img][/url]

Welcome to the whimsical universe of [i]Twinkleby[/i], where you explore a starlit archipelago of floating islands and decorate delightful dioramas. 

We are incredibly happy to say that our cozy game [b][i]Twinkleby[/i][/b] has been released today on PC, Mac, and Linux with full Steam Deck compatibility; for $16.99 USD / £14.29 GBP / €16.49 EUR; with a 15% Launch discount until October 3rd!

Just relax and decorate to your heart's desires with a wide range of tools at hand. Build tiny neighbourhoods, furnish the houses, and set the stage by changing the weather, seasons, and other intricate scenery details.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][b]Get Twinkleby on Steam![/b][/url] 
(15% Launch Sale up until October 3rd)

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S5IElqQZJ0o]Watch the [i]Twinkleby[/i] Release Trailer![/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0tvQLF21_o8]Watch the Fall asleep while I play Twinkleby (Full Game) with MadMorph[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/7995d4a82a71ac39e8de2fd6cce3e155982ae283.jpg[/img][/url]

However, you are not decorating only for yourself in [i]Twinkleby[/i]! Your creative choices will attract an ever-changing cast of adorable Neighbours that will make themselves at home on your cozy islands. Try to make these rascals happy or evict them, and send them floating off into the starlit skies with their tiny umbrellas!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/4349446cf3d48222bcaa9157a00abfeff55f6786.jpg[/img][/url]

Oh, but that´s not all! Two bundles have also been launched today on Steam that gives an additional 10% off the price!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58650]Twinkleby + Camper Van Bundle[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59486/]Twinkleby + Townscaper Bundle[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/2fc83751f3435dc5779a832f3c0231b66428e83f.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]About [i]Twinkleby[/i][/b]

Put your dazzling decoration skills to the test for your cute Neighbours and make them feel at home in your dapper dioramas. Feed them delicious food and fill their time with fun activities. No stress at all when it comes to satisfying their desires, as they will settle in on their own until you get around to giving them what they want.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/b50c6c0dd84b3d5efead3ce93d028abea32d1c11.jpg[/img][/url]

If your tiny friends overstay their welcome, just toss their bags off the island. They’ll take the hint, jump off the side of the island and soar away through the sky.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/3bb4d7d68b10477674c7e8b38a335cc150ef054e.jpg[/img][/url]

Expand your collection of shiny antiques and stylish garden decorations as you play. If you want to redo any part of your design, simply throw any item off the island’s edge and it'll be safely returned to your inventory.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/ec0cbc3e94853696d690638412243f9dfc2d598e.jpg[/img][/url]

Explore your starlit archipelago and unlock a smorgasbord of customization features, including a variety of weathers, seasons, backdrops as well as a colour palette for both your houses and all your decorative items. As you shape your islands in Twinkleby, you also change the soundtrack and gradually gain full control over the ambience of your dreamscape.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/92c50a7950095983ee3bd95c345781f77018d9fd.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Twinkleby Key Features:[/b]
✦ Aim for the stars – Follow the Twinkleby star chart to unlock new islands and collect map fragments to discover hidden ones.
✦ A smorgasbord of decoration – Grow your item collection and freely swap designs by tossing items over the island's edge, which are safely returned to your inventory.
✦ Decorate for your Neighbours – Attract both common and rare Neighbours, where the rare ones are drawn to your islands by how you decorate. If you tire of their company, simply send them on their way.
✦ Kindness is king – Make your Neighbours happy and they’ll reward you with gifts, from paintings and treasure keys to map fragments that leads to hidden islands.
✦ The soundtrack of your islands – Tailor ambience through weather, seasons, and backdrops, creating a unique soundscape for each island.
✦ Collect falling stars – Collect shooting stars known as Stellars and spend them at Molligan’s Antiques on new decorations. Earn more by delighting your Neighbours and uncovering secret ways to bring more stars tumbling from the sky.
✦ Keep a look-out for gifts from the skies – Claim chests that tumble past your islands and unlock new treasures for your collection.
✦ Take pretty pictures of your creations – Be sure to memorize your dazzling decorations in photo mode to capture all your delightful designs.
✦ Parallel islands – When you have delved deep into the Twinkleby universe, you will be able to play on new clean-slate versions of the islands you've discovered. Find new creative ways to decorate with all the items you've gathered!
✦ Sit back and relax – Enjoy stress-free, escapist gameplay without fail states or game overs.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/68be47ea7ee76697fbdec0b3768eb3b2ada4ea9a.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/800049297939f75636aca44903e8cf2ab9083a30.jpg[/img][/url]

We wish you all an amazing time in our cozy game Twinkleby 
All the very best from the devs at the indie studio Might & Delight 💖

But decoration isn’t just for yourself – your creative choices will attract a delightful cast of Neighbours who settle into your cozy designs. Supply them with food and activities, make them happy, or if you change your mind -- evict everyone and throw their furniture into space!

And should any of them overstay their welcome, you can simply toss their bags over the edge and by doing so send them drifting off into the starlit skies.

[b]✦ Take pretty pictures of your creations [/b]– Be sure to memorize your dazzling decorations in photo mode to capture all your delightful designs.

notes.title: Twinkleby chosen to “Ones to Play” at the Future Games Show ⭐
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/c13d63b1663f6b4495712b1b780bf250e28a7ec8.jpg[/img][/url]

Ever dreamed of decorating your own floating sky archipelago filled with curious creatures and peculiar antiques? We are incredibly happy to say that [i]Twinkleby[/i]—our upcoming cozy, quirky indie game — was spotlighted as “Ones to Play” during the Future Games Show at gamescom 2025! 🎉

[url=https://youtu.be/YkGKkpufaS8?si=xRNsFAMzYgGN1Pp5&t=10]Watch “Ones to Play” at the Future Games Show 2025[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow]Explore the Future Games Show Steam Event here![/url]

In [i]Twinkleby,[/i] you are invited into a starlit world where creativity knows no bounds. Decorate enchanting homes and gardens — whether charming, adorable, eccentric, or delightfully strange — and watch as whimsical residents arrive to settle on your islands, each drawn to your unique sense of style.

[i]Twinkleby [/i]is set to launch this fall on PC, Mac, and Linux, with full Steam Deck compatibility.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/1458b1fb97592336886cf88869ab695331cbba87.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]About [i]Twinkleby[/i][/b]

In [i]Twinkleby[/i], the whole world is your inventory. Here you can rebuild, redesign, discover new items and unlock a wide range of customization, including colors, backdrops, weathers and seasons. As you customize the scenery, you also change the soundtrack of your dreamscapes.

Based on your decoration choices, tiny neighbors will soon arrive on flying boats. Be aware that some are incredibly rare and only the most dedicated player will collect them all. If you feel your island is getting too crowded, simply throw your residents bags off the side of the island, and they’ll take the hint and soar away through the air. 

However, it might be a good idea to not be too hasty to say goodbye to them, since your tiny friends carry gifts for you if you make them happy. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/ae1e8385fd1c2364cc3d4baad588e4164e42730d.jpg[/img][/url]


If you suddenly want to shake things up, there´s a twist. You can simply toss your houses and items over the island’s edge! Don´t worry, anything thrown away will be safely returned to your collection. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/1689aa8ae7abf7d458a8b34b552bb66490fa1db5.jpg[/img][/url]

Of course, you can still decorate each of your islands to perfection and travel further along the Twinkleby star chart in search of new friends and lost islands.

notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/8c93852c684a710ef40d8e0e0b9aef2f0d56b5ac.jpg[/img][/url]

We are happy to announce our new indie game [i]Twinkleby[/i] – a cosy and relaxing decoration game where you turn floating islands into lovely dioramas and explore a starlit archipelago full of antique collectibles and quirky characters. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby]Find out more and Wishlist Twinkleby on Steam![/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y8y5-OsODps]Watch the Twinkleby announcement trailer here.[/url]

In [i]Twinkleby[/i], you will furnish your Victorian dollhouses and the gardens with an ever-expanding collection of decoration pieces. As you play, flying boats arrive to drop off new residents who make themselves at home on your islands.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/2051e46069a9b884042f35acf917992d2f88ad49.jpg[/img][/url]

These peculiar characters will interact with your creations and each other. They all have personalities of their own, and you need to figure out how to make them happy, because they’ll make sure to reward you for it.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/690d9cb6119f2f4a0b629b3f889a9a0ec15043a3.jpg[/img][/url]

Travel further into the floating archipelago, unlock bigger islands and build larger neighbourhoods to attract more cute and curious residents.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/68dca1c59c9014739eda6401d5b3e7183d47993a.jpg[/img][/url]

As you progress in the game, you will unlock backdrops and seasons for your island creations and receive new colours and variations for your furniture. While playing, you also transform the music by changing the weather and seasons in your own little corner of the sky.

[i]Twinkleby[/i] is a cosy single-player decoration game created by indie development studio Might & Delight, creators of the [i]Shelter [/i]games. The game is set to release on PC, Mac & Linux in 2025.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/5c5d2986a4c728e563036eba20a23637c64a7595.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]Twinkleby[/i] Key Features:
✦ Build neighbourhoods and decorate a variety of lush, floating islands with your growing collection of items.
✦ Furnish your houses to attract new cute residents that will make themselves at home. If you make them happy, they'll reward you.
✦ Choose the weather, season and backdrop for your colourful diorama and hear how the music changes with your choices for the scenery.
✦ Collect the shooting stars known as Stellars and spend them in Molligan’s Antiques on whatever catches your eye.
✦ Enjoy a cosy and peaceful gameplay in a widespread, floating archipelago without timed goals or lose conditions.

All the very best from the explorers at Might & Delight ❤️

notes.title: Back on Track: Might & Delight's Journey Forward
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/32963958/be45d9fb15777f15d89abe0a10c17c3ce0c42b55.jpg[/img]

As you may know, the video game industry is weathering a storm, and the team at Might & Delight have unfortunately not been spared from it. 

Earlier this year, we had to make the incredibly difficult decision to scale down our team. It has been a rough year, and we’ve been silent on our social channels as we’ve been focused on our team – both the friends that we’ve had to say goodbye to, and the team that remains. We’re still settling into our new normal, but we wanted to let you know that we are here, we´re working on our games and there are some things that we want to share with you.

We’ve been around for nearly fifteen years as an indie game developer, and we have a long, proud history of making games. We believe in game preservation and we aim to make sure our games are available to anyone who has supported us throughout the years. As we make decisions for existing titles and future projects, please know that this will be our guiding principle.

Our team is smaller now, and we will need to be mindful of how many projects we work on simultaneously to ensure that we keep our team healthy and our projects manageable. However, our intention is to keep up maintenance of our existing titles, as well as finish development of projects that have been in the pipeline for a while.

Regarding [i]Book of Travels,[/i] our main focus for the foreseeable future will be to roll out several patches that are in the making – including fixes and community requests – and we’re also aiming to, among other things, do a balancing pass for the inventory, and look into releasing some map updates. During the next couple of months, you’ll notice our activity picking up on Discord and Steam. We want you to know that we are here, we listen to your feedback and we’ll do our very best to keep you all in the loop as we roll out future patches.

We are excited to say that we have a new game project slated for release in the fall of 2025. When we were a bigger team, we worked on the concept of this game in parallel for a couple of years, and at the time of writing this, we’re already halfway through development. We look forward to sharing more about it with you in the new year. For now, however, our main focus will be on our existing game catalogue.

Also, for all you lovely people who supported[i] Book of Travels[/i] on Kickstarter; please keep an eye on Kickstarter updates and/or your inbox. Beyond upcoming Steam updates, we will also be sharing some information directly with all backers early next year. 

Throughout this year, the one thing we’ve always come back to is the fact that we have such an incredible community. We’re not exaggerating when we say that you are the main reason that we have managed to weather all the changes of 2024, and fight for a chance to not only continue the support of our previous games, but also to be able to release something new. 

A studio is only as good as its players, and we’re incredibly proud to have your support. Know that you can expect to see a lot more from us from now on. 

2024 has been a turbulent and chaotic year (for many, not just in the video game industry) so we want to wish you all a peaceful and cosy end of the year. We really hope to start off 2025 with a sense of normalcy, and we want to be more active – both with our online presence, and with our upcoming patches and announcements. 

Have an amazing Holiday and we’ll be in touch soon ❤
Cheers from all the developers at Might & Delight

[h2]MEADOW INTENTIONS RELEASE[/h2]

Introducing Intentions, a new feature intended both to give guidance to new players, and new things to do for seasoned Meadovians.

[quote] [i]“Meadow is an open-concept experience by nature, allowing the player to shape it any way they want. However, from time to time we were receiving feedback, especially from new players, that sometimes they find themselves looking for guidance and a goal to pursue when they launch the game. To make them feel included, we came up with [b]Intentions[/b]. 

[b]Intentions[/b] are our way to give you a spark of inspiration. A task to follow if you are looking for one, both short and long term – together with other players, or solo. You are rewarded for your efforts and the time you put into them, but the journey itself shall be a reward as well. That is why the tasks are focused on exploration and discovery, which have always been the foundation of the game, along with non-verbal communication. 

We hope that [b]Intentions[/b] will enrich your gameplay and you will enjoy them as much as we enjoyed creating them.”

[b]           Emilia Stoch, a game designer [/b][/i] [/quote]


Check the daily, weekly and monthly intentions in the Journal view. Complete an intention to earn a reward!
[list]
[*] The daily intention will be refreshed at 10:00 am (CET) every day.
[*] The weekly intention will be refreshed at 10:00 am (CET) every Monday.
[*] The monthly intention will be refreshed at 10:00 am (CET) on the 1st of each month.

[h3]Collect[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/26302118/0f93fc0c9f3bd732e847c19dec228fa17289426b.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/26302118/a23b4a76b16243fd7ada4576c116295eec807fdd.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/26302118/52cd8a6c98a0e69e495e69ba0cbe067d762b267a.png[/img]
The enter task requires entering a certain number of leaf piles, mud puddles, etc. within the deadline of the intention.

[i]Leopards (...) belong to the group of animals we recommend that you keep your distance from. A lot of us know how much it sucks to be clawed by a house cat, so imagine the absolute mayhem a cat ten times bigger can cause. But boy are they beautiful, with their majestic spots. Did you know that the spots of a leopard are called rosettes because they’re similar to roses in shape? Or that they can reach running speeds of up to 58 km/h? Oh, and they can jump up to 6 meters. Yeah, so don’t get on their bad side.

Koalas... they are cool. They sleep 18 hours a day, which we would too if we had the gall. They are very picky eaters; living exclusively off of eucalyptus leaves, despite these leaves being very low on nutrients (hence the long naps) and toxic to most other animals. Also, they’re the national symbol of Australian wildlife. The country known for having the scariest animals in the world uses the Koala as the symbol for their wildlife. Need we say more?
[/i]

Tomorrow we have yet another animal day to celebrate, but that announcement will come later today. Stay tuned!

Bears are very special, not least of which because of the fact that they are equally as adorable as they are scary. They are, after all, immensely powerful animals that eat pretty much anything. World Bear Day is meant to celebrate all eight species of bear, and to shine a light on the cruelties inflicted upon them by humans. Living bears are farmed for their bile in Asia, and they live under abhorrent conditions, suffering endlessly until they die in their phone booth sized cages. You may also have heard of "bear baiting", an illegal bloodsport where defenseless bears are forced to fight battle trained dogs for human entertainment. The fact that it's legal hasn't put a stop to it. 

In Meadow we will celebrate the bears by walking a mile in their shoes, in a world more humane, welcoming and playful than the real one. Join us!

notes.title: National Hedgehog Day in Meadow

Thank for joining us for Zebra Day yesterday! But the fun isn't over yet as tomorrow is National Hedgehog Day! The history of this day goes back all the way to Roman tradition, as the little critters were used as pre-TV weather men (no joke). As they were observed to hibernate during winter, the romans would look out for sightings of hedgehogs in February to predict warmer weather being imminent. If none were to be seen, it was taken as a sign of a prolonged winter.

Nowadays we know that these prickly creatures typically hibernate all the way into March, and we have actual human weathermen to pick up their duties. Still, National Hedgehog Day is still recognized as a thing, happening on February 2nd and while they aren't endangered their numbers are in decline because of habitat loss, dwindling food sources and parasites. So watch out for them when you mow your lawn!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26302118/3a8b3e9c01116fc06962d8ce06a510dacd9a81c3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hello Meadowers,[/h3]

The time has come for us to release the last in the planned series of anniversary skins. Today it's the Zebra & Hyena Skin Pack, and we hope you've enjoyed these skins! There are plans for more cosmetic DLC's in the future, both paid and free, but we will get back to you with more info on that later. Now, let's take a look at the Zebra and the Hyena, shall we? 

Zebras. Are they white with black stripes, or black with white stripes? This question keeps the entire scientific community up at night. We do know that their individual stripe patterns are unique to them, like our fingerprints are to us. A sad Zebra fact for you: they don’t sound anything like Chris Rock.

Hyenas are most known for their laugh like cackling, but not all species of hyena do them and it has nothing to do with their sense of humour. The “laugh” is an indication of nervous excitement or a sign of submission to a more dominant individual. If you want to learn something really freaky about hyenas you can look up their process of giving birth. We’re not going to go into detail here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26302118/944b70e5d6574a86f831b936a772a024432a1c39.jpg[/img]

Did you know that all peacocks are male? It makes sense when you think about it, but we’re so used to talking about peacocks as if they’re a species of bird rather than the males of one. The collective name is peafowl, the females are called peahens and the babies are peachicks. In Meadow, however, you can be a female peacock if you so wish. Who’s going to stop you?

The scarlet macaw is a gorgeous kind of parrot that you might envision sitting on the shoulder of a archetypal pirate. In the wild their life span is 40-50 years on average, but they’ve been known to live up to a staggering 90 years in captivity! The scarlet macaw is easily identified by its vibrant red body and the strikingly blue wings and is probably what most of us imagine when we hear the word parrot. And that beak is no joke, as it can snap a broomstick in half, allegedly. Not putting my finger in there, that’s for sure. Not to worry though, there’s no biting allowed in Meadow.

[h3]Hello! [/h3]

Another week, another premium skin pack. This time it's the Streaked Tenrec & Leopard Cub Skin Pack.

The lowland streaked tenrec, also known as the Madagascar hedgehog shrew, is as bizarre looking as it is endearing. Its most distinguishing features are the black coat with yellow streaks, its long nose and the black and yellow quills. It’s also the only mammal known to use stridulation, something that’s more common amongst insects and snakes. This means that they rub the tips of their quills together to generate a high frequency noise, thought to be a way for mother and babies to communicate. Unfortunately, they don’t come in blue and they don’t wear running shoes.

The leopard cub doesn’t need an introduction, surely. They’re kittens, but cooler since they have gorgeous spots and grow up to be beautiful and fearsome predators large enough to take you down in single combat. At Might and Delight we’re not afraid to break your heart, though, so here’s a sad fact for you: it’s estimated that less than 40% of leopard cubs survive their first year. Now, you may be curious about why the survival rate is so low, but we didn’t have it in us to research it. It could be leopard cub eating monsters for all we know. You go find out, if you really want that knowledge.

notes.title: Meadow Live Update November 1 2023
notes.content:
[h3]Meadow Classic[/h3]

For anyone who wants to play Meadow as it has been before this update, and any future update we apply, we've created a separate branch of the game that we call Meadow Classic. You can view it as Meadow frozen in time. Players on Classic will inhabit the same space as players on the regular branch, but won't get the benefit of new updates and won't see new skins or be able to engage with any new features. It's for those of you who want Meadow to stay exactly the same.

How to join Meadow Classic: 
[list]
[*] Right-click the game in your Steam library
[*] Go to Properties
[*] Go to Betas
[*] Choose "meadow_classic"
[/list]

[h3]New features[/h3]

[list]
[*] Initial support of HTTPS servers to avoid antiviruses blocking connections. The initial test server for this solution is called “Europe Beta”.
[*] Project is now updated to the newer version of Unity
[*] Sense mode now highlights flowers and puzzle pieces
[*] Analytics are now added to improve the current and future experience for the players
[*] The default setting of the camera for all new players will be the camera following the player; the existing players can pick this setting for camera behavior in the settings
[*] The settings now include the option to set culling to “eyesight” mode, that is supposed to reflect differences between the capabilities of different animals in the real world
[*] The eagle now has a smaller collider to ease the navigation while flying through the forests
[*] Remote config has been implemented to the project; for more information please check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kTHf4rBNx9I&ab_channel=MightandDelight]this video
[/url][*] News pop-up is now connected with the remote config tool and will be displaying news after each update
[*] New lobby screen
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] News popup: if there's no news, the game no longer hangs/crashes at boot
[*] The server ping reports are no longer unreliable, and do not falsely report server status
[*] Reworked network code in an attempt to make connections more reliable.
[*] Changes in network infrastructure
[*] The Den now displays the correct amount of essence on startup
[*] Spawning of collectables in the Jungle is working as intended - the abundance now becomes the new Jungle reality. Fruit and flowers enjoyers - rejoice!
[/list]

[h3]Known issues[/h3]

[list]
[*] Some meshes in the tropical region being distorted on some GPUs
[*] Funghi and crystals are not detected in the sense mode
[*] Some of the cloud models being rotated vertically
[*] Some people experience issues with connection and for some it still takes a few attempts

You're very welcome to report bugs and give feedback on your Meadow experience on our [url=https://discord.gg/JAQMkqr2vc]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: News from the Shelter team + New Shelter 3 trailer!
notes.content:
Hello! 

Today we are really excited to share this, our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UmqrVpFa2OU]new trailer[/url]! We hope you like it. Much like an elephant, development is coming along slowly but surely. Currently the team are working on elephant behaviours, level design and bringing some animal NPCs to life.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32963958/b4cdef15b969ac8356a562d3a8ad425454c98e40.jpg[/img]

[b]Elephant Development[/b]

But the truth is that we should have been further along than this by now, and today we're writing to let you know that we've had to revise our schedule - release is now set for a realistic early 2021. We're sorry - we know that some of you have been waiting so patiently! But we're a small team and along with updating [i]Meadow[/i], we just don't have the resources to move much faster than this. This means that we won't be working on any new updates for [i]Meadow[/i] until [i]Shelter 3[/i] is released. Pulling resources away from [i]Meadow[/i] means that we can fully commit to our deadline for [i]Shelter 3, [/i]however we [i]do[/i] have plans for some fun[i] Meadow [/i]updates when that time comes - we think it will be worth the wait!


[b]Meadow in the Meantime[/b]

[i]Meadow[/i] has been an unexpected high point in our journey and we want to say a huge thank you for making [i]Meadow[/i] what it is today - it's been four years of animal joy, and we've never stopped being surprised, touched and deeply grateful for all that you have produced and shared. [b]Thank you. [/b]

Our recent Kickstarter means that there's been a few new faces in [i]Meadow[/i] recently, and we'll continue to do more Play-with-the-devs events (one soon-to-be-announced for April). We also want you to know that the emotes you've been using so effectively will be gaining a sibling in our upcoming fairytale RPG, [i]Book of Travels.[/i] Again, to all [i]Meadow[/i] players, a huge thank you for helping us test and develop this communication system and showing us how magical it can be.

That's all for now - thank you for all your comments here on Steam! (We've been a little absent lately but we'll be around more often to say hello in the future.) 

Best Wishes,

Helen and the team at Might & Delight

notes.title: Anniversary Content Update 2018-10-24
notes.content:
Hello all!

It's been two years since we released Meadow (actually in 2 days, but we're cheating on that). It's been an interesting project to work with, and we've appreciated all your input and enthusiasm along the way. Todays update is a mix of a lot of ideas and input, shaped through an M&D lens.
Regardless if you're an old or new player, we hope that you'll enjoy our second anniversary update.

But without further ado, here is what's new for today:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26302118/d62f405596d1a0dc3570fde58308e9f5aa56495a.png[/img]


[b][u]Content additions[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] A new animal: Wolf (Unlocked by owning the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/942280/Symbols_A_Meadow_comic_book/]Symbols comic[/url])
[*] A new piece of land is now added to the world (next to the winter biome)
[*] A new music piece (tied to the new piece of land)
[*] A new toy: Snow piles
[*] One new skin for the Hedgehog ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/486310/discussions/0/1735462352456997189/]from the Hedgehog skin art contest[/url])
[*] 6 new achievements
[/list]

[b][u]Other changes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] There is now a way to change the resolution in the Connect screen (if it's far too small or large on your screen). Hold Left Shift and browse through the resolutions with UpArrow/DownArrow.
[*] The Eagle can now have the Home action.
[*] The sound effect when other players pick up items is now a limited effect in the audio menu.
[*] The grove number and server name is now on top of the pause menu.
[*] The block/mute animals menu now only shows the distance of the closest animals.
[*] You can now lock the emote hotbar.
[*] There is now a north facing arrow in the map view.
[*] You can now hold Left Control when scrolling to zoom the camera to change the vertical offset of the camera.
[/list]

[b][u]Bug fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Muted and blocked animals are now saved between sessions.
[*] The bug where an animal would walk a little bit forward after backing and then stopping is now solved.
[*] Various level bugs fixed.
[/list]

[b][u]Hotfixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] A lot of laggyness that came with the update should now be solved.
[*] The hidden achievement should now trigger as intended.
[*] The amount of animals in the pause view should now be correct.
[*] The waterfall sound where the river enters the sea is now removed.
[*] The new music track now has a delay, and then a percentage chance if it will start playing.
[*] Performance drops in certain areas that were new to the update should now be fixed.
[*] Certain translations are now updated.
[*] The Hide-button in the UI should now work again.
[*] The wolf emotes should now be as high-res as all other emotes.
[*] Snow piles should now be easier to see.
[*] The first wolf voice should now be louder.
[*] Change Camera Height is now key bindable.
[*] The new north arrow on the map is now togglable in the Gameplay settings.
[*] The Wolfs walking speed is slightly adjusted to fit the animation.
[*] The Wolfs collision is now adjusted (should solve issues like difficulties to jump on steep walls etc.)
[*] The Bear cub now have footprints and footstep sounds again.
[*] The Wolf should now not make idle head movements while drinking.
[*] The new areas music should now not be able to be interrupted in the middle.
[*] The randomization of the new areas music should now be more even.
[*] The water should now be affected by fog again.
[*] The correct hedgehog skin should now be displayed in the Puzzle screen.
[*] The idle head movements should not not trigger together with the play action.
[*] The auto-find of resolution when one first starts the game should now be better.
[*] Several issues with particle changes should now be solved (particles should no longer linger, there should now not be autumn leaves in the autumn cave after you respawn there, etc.)
[/list]

notes.title: Content update 2018-07-25
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

There has been some discussion on the forum about accessibility and customizations, and this update is mainly dedicated to improving the experience for everyone.
Happy Meadowing!

[b][u]Content additions[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new Hedgehog skins
[*] You can now customize which Goat horns that go with which skin
[*] There are now symbols in the den screen to clarify where the animals are placed. This can be turned off in the Gameplay Settings menu.
[*] You can now choose which songs you want in your music mix, and how frequently they appear (in the Audio Settings menu)
[*] There is now a system to prevent sound stacking. In the Audio Settings menu, if you flip to the second page, there is now settings to tweak certain effects (you can turn them off, or have the sounds be unlimited). You can also toggle their visual effects there.
[*] You can now mute and block other players in the Character Options menu.
[*] You can now toggle the space effects in the Gameplay menu.
[*] You can now set the intensity of the tree movement in the Gameplay menu.
[/list]


[b][u]Other changes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The day/night transitions are now slower
[*] The Fire 3D emote now spreads light in night time
[*] The mud effect now fades away after a while.
[*] You can now switch between voices in the regular game view. The voice options are toggled with a button under the emote categories (emotes, commands, actions, special).
[/list]

[b][u]Bug fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The space track volume is now controlled by the music volume instead of the sound volume.
[*] The paths in the world that disappeared a few updates ago are now back.
[/list]

[b][u]Hotfixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The voices-button in the interface now gets hidden by the hide-button
[*] You can now stop the sample tracks in the Audio Settings menu
[*] Removed the mud timeout for now (because more people appreciated being mudded until changed, and it's togglabe if you don't want to be mudded by others)
[*] The Eagles emote maps no longer gets reset to exclamation marks when mapped to 3D emotes
[*] The Tree Movement slider should now work
[*] The Other Players list in CharacterOptionsView now doesn't display names if you have Block Names enabled
[*] The Other Players list in CharacterOptionsView should now not stop working after a while
[*] The Other Players list in CharacterOptionsView should now update the list, names, and distances continuously
[*] When you have voices enabled in the interface, hide the interface, and show the map, the voices now also keep hidden
[*] The issue that some 3D emotes (ex. the Counting Flower) stops working for a bit after changing characters should be solved
[*] The Hedgehog no longer gets suspended mid-air when using its play action in the middle of a jump
[/list]

notes.title: Anniversary content update 2017-10-25
notes.content:
We're happy to release this autumn-themed celebration to Meadows' first birthday! (Technically it's tomorrow, October 26th, but we're doing a little head start since it's a wednesday today.)
Whether you were in the beta group, or just picked this up, we hope you'll enjoy the update. See you all in the Meadow!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26302118/e5c3f1cbfb991cb80ae9d93cd74591e21768b7a4.png[/img]

[u][b]Content additions[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] New animal: Hedgehog
	The first animal who never have appeared in another Shelter game, [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/rukx3bb88pt7shd/HedgehogReveal.gif]the Hedgehog[/url] have now waddled into the Meadow!

[*] New collectable category: Mushrooms
	24 types of mushrooms are now available to find in the Meadow. Divided up in common, rare, and fabled, these fungal treats should light up quite a few strolls in the woods and caves. A task for Doctor Malcom, or will someone else step up?

[*] New pheasant skin
	A new skin based on the winning entry from the pheasant skin art contest, by SeleneTheWerewolf!

[*] New toy: Leaf piles
	Jump around and rejoice in these poofy piles for some autumn feeling.

[*] 9 new achievements
	Related to the Hedgehog, the mushrooms, and the leaf piles.

[*] New language: Ukranian is now available thanks to Mykhailo Radzievskyi!
[/list]


[u][b]Other changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Camera zoom in/out is now available to keybind in the controls menu.
[/list]


[u][b]Bug fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Some food not giving essence should be solved.
[*] Food sometimes getting stuck in an animals mouth should be solved.
[*] Badger animation freeze in the drink animation solved.
[*] Some animals sometimes not being clickable in the den should be solved.
[*] The catnip mode getting stuck when sensing again when the effect is going out should be solved.
[*] Invisible buttons in the den reacting (made the mouse over sound) solved.
[*] Many level bugs (weird spawning places, flying grass, etc.) have been solved.
[/list]

[u][b]Hotfixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Hedgehogs no longer get a lighter colour when getting muddy.
[*] The sound when the hedgehog lands from a greater height should now be audible.
[*] The puzzle view not showing the hedgehog image when it's fully unlocked solved.
[*] A few localization errors fixed
[*] Clicking on animals available in the connection screen fixed
[*] Names of animals sometimes changing to gibberish should be solved
[/list]

notes.title: Shelter Creators Announce Explore Em Up Meadow
notes.content:
Pip once speculated that Might & Delight’s upcoming Meadow [official site] might be a game in which you play as a mommy meadow nurturing a litter of baby meadows, keeping in line with Shelter’s tradition. While that is a game I would certainly be interested in, it seems Might & Delight has a different vision for their latest project.

Unlike Shelter 1 and 2, Meadow seems to be less about struggling to keep your cubs from succumbing to a nasty demise, and more about making friends. Lynx walk side-by-side with fox and deer in blissful harmony. Sure, that doesn’t make a whole lot of sense in the real world, but Meadow is all about exploring and the social experience. Might & Delight heralds the game as a sort of nature playground.
